title: Water closets for children’s use.
officialText:
In nurseries, schools, and similar places where plumbing fixtures are provided for the use of
children under 6 years of age, such water closets shall be of a size and height suitable for the children’s use.
SECTION PC 421
WHIRLPOOL BATHTUBS
